verdict.rationale: Orama's docs cover the core steps of the story: creating a database instance with an indexing schema, inserting documents (described as quick and intuitive, with `insertMultiple` for larger sets), and running full-text search, with simple install via npm, a browser CDN import, or Deno. The pack does not show a dedicated quickstart, a basic search call, or any hands-on evidence that a first search takes only minutes. missing for 10: an evidenced end-to-end quickstart guide, a documented basic search() example, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-search.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create an index, add documents, and run my first search within minutes of starting the quickstart
